messages.content: What does the auto-bot module do?
The auto-bot module — Autonomous task bot: gather, craft, build, farm and more. It is in the Log Client category and has 25 settings.
Which category is auto-bot in?
auto-bot is in the Log Client category.
What does the auto-bot setting auto-start do?
auto-start in auto-bot (Boolean) — Start working as soon as an objective is added. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting pause-on-disconnect do?
pause-on-disconnect in auto-bot (Boolean) — Pause the bot when the world changes or the connection drops. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting task-timeout do?
task-timeout in auto-bot (Integer) — Seconds a single task may run before it is failed. Its default is 120.
What does the auto-bot setting retry-limit do?
retry-limit in auto-bot (Integer) — How many times a failing step is retried before the task fails. Its default is 3.
What does the auto-bot setting gather-radius do?
gather-radius in auto-bot (Integer) — How far the bot searches for blocks to gather. Its default is 32.
What does the auto-bot setting max-scan-results do?
max-scan-results in auto-bot (Integer) — Upper bound on blocks returned by one search. Its default is 512.
What does the auto-bot setting min-tool-durability do?
min-tool-durability in auto-bot (Integer) — Durability below which a tool is reported as worn. Its default is 10.
What does the auto-bot setting container-radius do?
container-radius in auto-bot (Integer) — How far the bot searches for containers to store items in. Its default is 16.
What does the auto-bot setting arrival-tolerance do?
arrival-tolerance in auto-bot (Double) — How close counts as arrived, in blocks. Its default is 2.0.
What does the auto-bot setting max-travel-distance do?
max-travel-distance in auto-bot (Double) — Longest route the bot will attempt, in blocks. Its default is 256.
What does the auto-bot setting walk-on-water do?
walk-on-water in auto-bot (Boolean) — Allow the path manager to cross water. Ignored without Baritone or Voyager. Its default is false.
What does the auto-bot setting walk-on-lava do?
walk-on-lava in auto-bot (Boolean) — Allow the path manager to cross lava. Ignored without Baritone or Voyager. Its default is false.
What does the auto-bot setting path-step do?
path-step in auto-bot (Boolean) — Allow the path manager to step up single blocks. Ignored without Baritone or Voyager. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting path-no-fall do?
path-no-fall in auto-bot (Boolean) — Allow the path manager to fall safely. Ignored without Baritone or Voyager. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting pause-on-danger do?
pause-on-danger in auto-bot (Boolean) — Pause the bot when health or food drops below the safety thresholds. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting health-threshold do?
health-threshold in auto-bot (Double) — Pause when health is at or below this many half-hearts. Its default is 8.
What does the auto-bot setting food-threshold do?
food-threshold in auto-bot (Integer) — Pause when food is at or below this many shanks. Its default is 6.
What does the auto-bot setting action-cooldown do?
action-cooldown in auto-bot (Integer) — Milliseconds between two bot actions. Its default is 100.
What does the auto-bot setting actions-per-tick do?
actions-per-tick in auto-bot (Integer) — How many bot actions may run per tick. Its default is 1.
What does the auto-bot setting low-performance-mode do?
low-performance-mode in auto-bot (Boolean) — Halve the search radius and the per-tick budget on a slow machine. Its default is false.
What does the auto-bot setting persist-memory do?
persist-memory in auto-bot (Boolean) — Save waypoints and objectives to disk. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting memory-file do?
memory-file in auto-bot (String) — Where the bot memory is stored. Leave blank for the default location.
What does the auto-bot setting verbosity do?
verbosity in auto-bot (Verbosity) — How much the bot reports in chat. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the auto-bot setting chat-feedback do?
chat-feedback in auto-bot (Boolean) — Print bot status changes to chat. Its default is true.
What does the auto-bot setting hud do?
hud in auto-bot (Boolean) — Show the bot status HUD. Its default is false.
What does the chat-digest module do?
The chat-digest module — Summarises chat activity on demand and on a timer. It is in the Log Client category and has 5 settings.
Which category is chat-digest in?
chat-digest is in the Log Client category.
What does the chat-digest setting automatic do?
automatic in chat-digest (Boolean) — Print a digest automatically on a timer. Its default is false.
What does the chat-digest setting interval-minutes do?
interval-minutes in chat-digest (Integer) — Minutes between automatic digests. Its default is 30.
What does the chat-digest setting window-size do?
window-size in chat-digest (Integer) — How many recent messages a digest covers. Its default is 200.
What does the chat-digest setting top-players do?
top-players in chat-digest (Integer) — How many players to list in a digest. Its default is 5.
What does the chat-digest setting send-to-webhook do?
send-to-webhook in chat-digest (Boolean) — Also send each digest to the configured webhook. Its default is false.
What does the chat-filter module do?
The chat-filter module — Suppresses chat noise with ordered hide/allow rules. It is in the Log Client category and has 3 settings.
Which category is chat-filter in?
chat-filter is in the Log Client category.
What does the chat-filter setting rules do?
rules in chat-filter (List<String>) — Filter rules, one per line, applied top to bottom. First match wins. Its default is computed at startup.
What does the chat-filter setting default-action do?
default-action in chat-filter (ChatFilterRule.Action) — What to do with a message no rule matches. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the chat-filter setting announce-hides do?
announce-hides in chat-filter (Boolean) — Print a chat note the first time a rule hides a message. Its default is false.
What does the chat-logger module do?
The chat-logger module — Records chat to disk for search, export and stats. It is in the Log Client category and has 27 settings.
Which category is chat-logger in?
chat-logger is in the Log Client category.
What does the chat-logger setting recording do?
recording in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record incoming chat to disk. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting chat-feedback do?
chat-feedback in chat-logger (Boolean) — Print recording status changes to chat. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting duplicate-detection do?
duplicate-detection in chat-logger (Boolean) — Ignore a line that repeats the same sender and text within the window. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting duplicate-window-ms do?
duplicate-window-ms in chat-logger (Integer) — How close two identical lines must be to count as a duplicate. Its default is 250.
What does the chat-logger setting public-chat do?
public-chat in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record public chat messages. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting player-messages do?
player-messages in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record direct messages. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting system do?
system in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record system messages. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting joins do?
joins in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record join notifications. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting leaves do?
leaves in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record leave notifications. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting deaths do?
deaths in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record death messages. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting announcements do?
announcements in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record server announcements. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting game do?
game in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record game notifications (advancements, mode changes). Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting other do?
other in chat-logger (Boolean) — Record anything that does not fit another category. Its default is false.
What does the chat-logger setting save-logs do?
save-logs in chat-logger (Boolean) — Persist recorded chat to disk. Its default is true.
What does the chat-logger setting storage-directory do?
storage-directory in chat-logger (String) — Folder for the logs, relative to the game directory. Its default is logclient/logs.
What does the chat-logger setting compression-level do?
compression-level in chat-logger (Integer) — GZIP level for stored segments (1 fastest, 9 smallest). Its default is 6.
What does the chat-logger setting flush-threshold do?
flush-threshold in chat-logger (Integer) — Entries buffered before a segment is written to disk. Its default is 250.
What does the chat-logger setting auto-cleanup do?
auto-cleanup in chat-logger (Boolean) — Enforce the limits below automatically after each flush and at startup. Off by default: logs are never deleted unless you ask. Its default is false.
What does the chat-logger setting max-age-days do?
max-age-days in chat-logger (Integer) — Delete log segments older than this. 0 keeps every segment forever. Its default is 0.
What does the chat-logger setting max-size-mb do?
max-size-mb in chat-logger (Integer) — Maximum total size of the stored logs, oldest segments first. 0 keeps every segment regardless of size. Its default is 0.
What does the chat-logger setting max-segments do?
max-segments in chat-logger (Integer) — Maximum number of stored segments. 0 keeps every segment. Its default is 0.
What does the chat-logger setting export-format do?
export-format in chat-logger (LogExporter.Format) — Default format used by the export controls. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the chat-logger setting webhook-url do?
webhook-url in chat-logger (String) — Discord webhook URL used by Send Now and periodic reports. Never written to saved logs.
What does the chat-logger setting webhook-username do?
webhook-username in chat-logger (String) — Display name used for webhook reports. Its default is Log Client.
What does the chat-logger setting auto-reports do?
auto-reports in chat-logger (Boolean) — Send a report to the webhook on a fixed interval. Its default is false.
What does the chat-logger setting report-interval-minutes do?
report-interval-minutes in chat-logger (Integer) — Minutes between automatic reports. Its default is 5.
What does the chat-logger setting keyword-webhook-url do?
keyword-webhook-url in chat-logger (String) — Send keyword alerts to this Discord webhook instead of the one above, so a noisy word does not bury the reports. Blank inherits the webhook above.
What does the chat-monitor module do?
The chat-monitor module — Live chat feed with search, filters and highlighting. It is in the Log Client category and has 10 settings.
Which category is chat-monitor in?
chat-monitor is in the Log Client category.
What does the chat-monitor setting feed-size do?
feed-size in chat-monitor (Integer) — How many recent messages the live feed keeps. Its default is 10.
What does the chat-monitor setting show-timestamps do?
show-timestamps in chat-monitor (Boolean) — Prefix each live message with its time. Its default is true.
What does the chat-monitor setting show-sender do?
show-sender in chat-monitor (Boolean) — Prefix each live message with the sender name. Its default is true.
What does the chat-monitor setting shown-types do?
shown-types in chat-monitor (List<String>) — Message categories shown in the live feed (ids such as public_chat, system). Its default is a built-in list of defaults.
What does the chat-monitor setting highlight-words do?
highlight-words in chat-monitor (List<String>) — Words highlighted in the live feed. Its default is diamondnetheriteelytra.
What does the chat-monitor setting highlight-players do?
highlight-players in chat-monitor (List<String>) — Players whose messages are highlighted.
What does the chat-monitor setting ignore-words do?
ignore-words in chat-monitor (List<String>) — Messages containing any of these words are hidden from the live feed.
What does the chat-monitor setting ignore-players do?
ignore-players in chat-monitor (List<String>) — Messages from these players are hidden from the live feed.
What does the chat-monitor setting notification-sounds do?
notification-sounds in chat-monitor (Boolean) — Play a click when a highlighted message arrives. Its default is false.
What does the chat-monitor setting desktop-notifications do?
desktop-notifications in chat-monitor (Boolean) — Post a highlighted message to the notification centre. Its default is false.
What does the chat-timestamps module do?
The chat-timestamps module — Prefixes incoming chat with the time it arrived. It is in the Log Client category and has 2 settings.
Which category is chat-timestamps in?
chat-timestamps is in the Log Client category.
What does the chat-timestamps setting style do?
style in chat-timestamps (ChatTimestampFormat.Style) — How much of the clock to show. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the chat-timestamps setting dim do?
dim in chat-timestamps (Boolean) — Draw the prefix in dark grey so the message stays the brightest part of the line. Its default is true.
What does the companion module do?
The companion module — Serve a small web dashboard so a phone or another machine can watch and control this client. It is in the Log Client category and has 8 settings.
Which category is companion in?
companion is in the Log Client category.
What are the aliases for companion?
companion can also be reached as: web, remote, app.
What does the companion setting port do?
port in companion (Integer) — The TCP port the companion listens on. Its default is 6767.
What does the companion setting node-name do?
node-name in companion (String) — The name this client shows up as in the app. Its default is Log Client.
What does the companion setting allow-remote do?
allow-remote in companion (Boolean) — Also listen on other interfaces. Anyone who can reach the port and knows the token can control this client. Its default is false.
What does the companion setting bind-address do?
bind-address in companion (String) — The interface to bind when remote access is allowed. Its default is 0.0.0.0.
What does the companion setting token do?
token in companion (String) — The access token the app must present. Regenerate it if it is ever exposed.
What does the companion setting publish-chat do?
publish-chat in companion (Boolean) — Stream new chat lines to the app as they arrive. Its default is true.
What does the companion setting publish-bot do?
publish-bot in companion (Boolean) — Stream bot state and task changes to the app. Its default is true.
What does the companion setting notify-on-connect do?
notify-on-connect in companion (Boolean) — Show a notification when a client connects or disconnects. Its default is true.
What does the keyword-alerts module do?
The keyword-alerts module — Alerts on configurable keywords with sound and webhook options. It is in the Log Client category and has 8 settings.
Which category is keyword-alerts in?
keyword-alerts is in the Log Client category.
What does the keyword-alerts setting rules do?
rules in keyword-alerts (List<String>) — Keyword rules, one per line: pattern;case=;whole=;sound=;webhook=;enabled=;color= Its default is a built-in list of defaults.
What does the keyword-alerts setting chat-feedback do?
chat-feedback in keyword-alerts (Boolean) — Print a chat note when a keyword matches. Its default is false.
What does the keyword-alerts setting cooldown-seconds do?

cooldown-seconds in keyword-alerts (Integer) — Shortest gap between two alerts for the same rule. Matches inside the gap are counted and reported with the next alert instead of printing a line each. Its default is 2.
What does the keyword-alerts setting burst-limit do?
burst-limit in keyword-alerts (Integer) — Most alerts allowed in ten seconds, across every rule. Keeps a common word from flooding chat and the webhook. Its default is 6.
What does the keyword-alerts setting webhook-url do?
webhook-url in keyword-alerts (String) — Discord webhook URL used by rules that enable webhook notifications. Kept out of saved data.
What does the keyword-alerts setting webhook-username do?
webhook-username in keyword-alerts (String) — Display name used for webhook alerts. Its default is Log Client.
What does the keyword-alerts setting periodic-summary do?
periodic-summary in keyword-alerts (Boolean) — Also send a periodic chat summary to the webhook. Its default is false.
What does the keyword-alerts setting summary-interval-minutes do?
summary-interval-minutes in keyword-alerts (Integer) — Minutes between periodic summaries. Its default is 15.
What does the mention-alerts module do?
The mention-alerts module — Alerts when your name or a watched name is used in chat. It is in the Log Client category and has 9 settings.
Which category is mention-alerts in?
mention-alerts is in the Log Client category.
What does the mention-alerts setting names do?
names in mention-alerts (List<String>) — Names to watch, one per line. Your own name is added automatically.
What does the mention-alerts setting include-own-name do?
include-own-name in mention-alerts (Boolean) — Also alert when your own player name is mentioned. Its default is true.
What does the mention-alerts setting others-only do?
others-only in mention-alerts (Boolean) — Ignore lines you sent yourself. Its default is true.
What does the mention-alerts setting cooldown-seconds do?

cooldown-seconds in mention-alerts (Integer) — Shortest gap between two alerts for the same name. Mentions inside the gap are counted and reported with the next alert instead of printing a line each. Its default is 2.
What does the mention-alerts setting burst-limit do?

burst-limit in mention-alerts (Integer) — Most alerts allowed in ten seconds, across every watched name. Keeps a busy server from flooding chat even when many different names are hit. Its default is 6.
What does the mention-alerts setting sound do?
sound in mention-alerts (Boolean) — Play a note when a watched name is mentioned. Its default is true.
What does the mention-alerts setting notification do?
notification in mention-alerts (Boolean) — Raise a notification for each mention. Its default is true.
What does the mention-alerts setting chat-feedback do?
chat-feedback in mention-alerts (Boolean) — Print a chat note for each mention. Its default is false.
What does the mention-alerts setting webhook do?
webhook in mention-alerts (Boolean) — Send a mention embed to the shared webhook. Its default is false.
What does the notifications module do?
The notifications module — Central notification stream: chat, sound and history for every Log Client feature. It is in the Log Client category and has 6 settings.
Which category is notifications in?
notifications is in the Log Client category.
What does the notifications setting chat-feedback do?

chat-feedback in notifications (Boolean) — Print accepted notifications to chat. Off by default: the modules that raise a notification usually print it themselves, and enabling both would double it. Its default is false.
What does the notifications setting chat-min-priority do?
chat-min-priority in notifications (NotificationPriority) — Only print notifications at or above this priority to chat. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the notifications setting sound do?
sound in notifications (Boolean) — Play a sound for notifications at or above the sound priority. Its default is false.
What does the notifications setting sound-min-priority do?
sound-min-priority in notifications (NotificationPriority) — Only play a sound for notifications at or above this priority. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the notifications setting volume do?
volume in notifications (Double) — Notification sound volume. Its default is 1.0.
What does the notifications setting hud do?
hud in notifications (Boolean) — Show the recent-notifications HUD. Its default is false.
What does the player-activity module do?
The player-activity module — Tracks and displays per-player chat activity. It is in the Log Client category and has 4 settings.
Which category is player-activity in?
player-activity is in the Log Client category.
What does the player-activity setting rebuild-on-activate do?
rebuild-on-activate in player-activity (Boolean) — Rebuild the player index from stored logs when the module is enabled. Its default is true.
What does the player-activity setting min-messages do?
min-messages in player-activity (Integer) — Hide players below this message count in the overview. Its default is 0.
What does the player-activity setting max-players do?
max-players in player-activity (Integer) — How many players to keep in the session summary. 0 keeps every player. Its default is 0.
What does the player-activity setting excluded-players do?
excluded-players in player-activity (List<String>) — Players never tracked or listed (one name per line).
What does the player-identity module do?
The player-identity module — Tracks observed player name changes and a per-account watchlist. It is in the Log Client category and has 5 settings.
Which category is player-identity in?
player-identity is in the Log Client category.
What does the player-identity setting track-identities do?
track-identities in player-identity (Boolean) — Record the names each account is seen using. Its default is true.
What does the player-identity setting max-accounts do?
max-accounts in player-identity (Integer) — How many accounts to remember. 0 keeps every account. Its default is 0.
What does the player-identity setting notify-renames do?
notify-renames in player-identity (Boolean) — Raise a notification when an account is seen under a new name. Its default is true.
What does the player-identity setting watched-only do?
watched-only in player-identity (Boolean) — Only notify for players on the watchlist. Its default is false.
What does the player-identity setting watchlist do?
watchlist in player-identity (List<String>) — Player names to watch (one per line). Watched renames are always highlighted.
What does the player-notes module do?
The player-notes module — Keeps notes about players and links them to observed activity. It is in the Log Client category and has 4 settings.
Which category is player-notes in?
player-notes is in the Log Client category.
What does the player-notes setting notes do?
notes in player-notes (List<String>) — Saved notes, managed from the Notes screen. Editing this by hand is not recommended. Its default is computed at startup.
What does the player-notes setting max-notes do?
max-notes in player-notes (Integer) — How many player notes to keep. 0 keeps every note. Its default is a built-in default size.
What does the player-notes setting chat-feedback do?
chat-feedback in player-notes (Boolean) — Print a chat note when a note is saved or removed. Its default is true.
What does the player-notes setting show-activity do?
show-activity in player-notes (Boolean) — Show a player's observed activity alongside their note. Its default is true.
What does the repeat-collapse module do?
The repeat-collapse module — Hides repeated identical chat lines and reports how many times one repeated. It is in the Log Client category and has 3 settings.
Which category is repeat-collapse in?
repeat-collapse is in the Log Client category.
What does the repeat-collapse setting window do?
window in repeat-collapse (Integer) — How soon the same line must arrive to count as a repeat, in milliseconds. Its default is 3000.
What does the repeat-collapse setting announce-count do?
announce-count in repeat-collapse (Boolean) — Print how many times a line was repeated once the run ends. Its default is true.
What does the repeat-collapse setting ignore-own do?
ignore-own in repeat-collapse (Boolean) — Do not collapse your own messages, so a macro you are testing stays visible. Its default is false.
What does the schematic-dropper module do?
The schematic-dropper module — Automated schematic material dropping. It is in the Log Client category and has 43 settings.
Which category is schematic-dropper in?
schematic-dropper is in the Log Client category.
What does the schematic-dropper setting auto-continue do?
auto-continue in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Keep dropping until every required material has been processed. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting operation-delay do?
operation-delay in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds to wait between two drop operations. Its default is 120.
What does the schematic-dropper setting retry-limit do?
retry-limit in schematic-dropper (Integer) — How many times a failed operation is retried before the material is skipped. Its default is 3.
What does the schematic-dropper setting retry-backoff do?
retry-backoff in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds to wait before retrying a failed operation. Its default is 250.
What does the schematic-dropper setting recovery-mode do?
recovery-mode in schematic-dropper (RecoveryMode) — Strict Order waits for the current material; Best Effort blocks it and moves on. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting pause-on-missing do?
pause-on-missing in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Wait for materials instead of finishing when something is missing. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting completion-notification do?
completion-notification in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Announce in chat when every material has been dropped. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting material-list do?
material-list in schematic-dropper (List<String>) — Material list to drop. One entry per line, e.g. minecraft:cobblestone 128. Its default is computed at startup.
What does the schematic-dropper setting material-file do?
material-file in schematic-dropper (String) — Full path to a material list (.txt/.md/.csv) or schematic, used by "Import Path".
What does the schematic-dropper setting ordering-mode do?
ordering-mode in schematic-dropper (OrderingMode) — Order in which materials are processed. Stays fixed for the whole run. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting rotation-enabled do?
rotation-enabled in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Rotate the player's head toward the intended drop direction. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting rotation-mode do?
rotation-mode in schematic-dropper (RotationMode) — Instant snaps to the target; Smooth interpolates. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting rotation-speed do?
rotation-speed in schematic-dropper (Double) — Degrees per tick the head moves in Smooth mode. Its default is 30.
What does the schematic-dropper setting restore-rotation do?
restore-rotation in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Restore the original head rotation when the run stops or completes. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting target-update-interval do?
target-update-interval in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds between target re-evaluations. Its default is 100.
What does the schematic-dropper setting rotation-debug do?
rotation-debug in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Print rotation targets to chat. Its default is false.
What does the schematic-dropper setting drop-pitch-offset do?
drop-pitch-offset in schematic-dropper (Double) — Vertical offset of the player-position target, in blocks. Its default is -1.0.
What does the schematic-dropper setting inventory-mode do?
inventory-mode in schematic-dropper (InventoryMode) — Silent clicks the screen handler directly; Open Inventory opens the inventory first. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting stack-strategy do?
stack-strategy in schematic-dropper (StackStrategy) — Which stack of a material to use first. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting drop-action do?
drop-action in schematic-dropper (DropAction) — Drop One throws single items; Drop Full Stack throws whole stacks when allowed. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting sync-timeout do?
sync-timeout in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds to wait for the server to confirm an operation. Its default is 1500.
What does the schematic-dropper setting rescan-interval do?
rescan-interval in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds between inventory rescans while waiting for materials. Its default is 1000.
What does the schematic-dropper setting target-mode do?
target-mode in schematic-dropper (TargetMode) — Where to aim the drop. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting validate-target do?
validate-target in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Skip rotation when the target is invalid instead of rotating to bad coordinates. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting hud-enabled do?
hud-enabled in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Show the progress HUD element. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting notify-progress do?
notify-progress in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Report each confirmed drop in chat. Its default is false.
What does the schematic-dropper setting auto-acquire do?
auto-acquire in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Create missing materials automatically while in Creative mode. Its default is false.
What does the schematic-dropper setting auto-drop do?
auto-drop in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Drop acquired batches through the normal dropping workflow so large lists fit. Its default is true.
What does the schematic-dropper setting acquire-delay do?
acquire-delay in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds between two creative gives. Its default is 80.
What does the schematic-dropper setting acquire-retry-limit do?
acquire-retry-limit in schematic-dropper (Integer) — How many times a rejected creative give is retried before the material waits. Its default is 3.
What does the schematic-dropper setting acquire-sync-timeout do?
acquire-sync-timeout in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds to wait for the server to confirm a creative give. Its default is 1500.
What does the schematic-dropper setting acquire-scan-interval do?
acquire-scan-interval in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Milliseconds between inventory re-scans while waiting for space. Its default is 500.
What does the schematic-dropper setting build-enabled do?
build-enabled in schematic-dropper (Boolean) — Place a loaded schematic block by block, verifying every placement. Its default is false.
What does the schematic-dropper setting origin do?
origin in schematic-dropper (BuildOriginMode) — Where the schematic is anchored. Its default is a built-in default.
What does the schematic-dropper setting origin-x do?
origin-x in schematic-dropper (Integer) — X coordinate used when Origin is set to Custom. Its default is 0.
What does the schematic-dropper setting origin-y do?
origin-y in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Y coordinate used when Origin is set to Custom. Its default is 64.
What does the schematic-dropper setting origin-z do?
origin-z in schematic-dropper (Integer) — Z coordinate used when Origin is set to Custom. Its default is 0.
What does the schematic-dropper setting conflicts do?

What is the companion access token?

The shared secret the companion server requires. Sent as an Authorization Bearer header or a token query parameter. The server binds to loopback by default and refuses a remote bind without an explicit opt-in.
What is the webhook relay?

One-way delivery of chat events to Discord as rich embeds. Opt-in: nothing is sent until a URL is configured. A failed delivery is retried for transient errors (network, 5xx, 429) and dropped for a 4xx, because a rejected payload will not become valid on a retry.
What is the embed character budget?

Discord rejects an embed whose visible text exceeds 6000 characters across all its parts. Each part is clipped to its own limit and to the remaining total budget as it is added, so the sum cannot exceed the limit.
What is the leading slash rule?

The companion chat endpoint forwards a message starting with '/' to the command path, which runs it as the player. Any external input must have leading slashes stripped first, or it becomes remote command execution.
What is the chat event field names?
The companion event stream names a chat line's text 'content', following ChatEntry.toMap(). The snapshot names the same field 'message', following ChatEntryView. A consumer must accept both.
What is the Discord bridge?

tools/discord_bridge.py mirrors a Discord channel and Minecraft chat in both directions, on top of the companion API. It is a separate Python process, not part of the mod, because a bot token must not ship inside a client mod and a bot has to stay online when the game is closed.
What is the bridge echo suppression?

A Discord message becomes a Minecraft chat line, which the bridge would read back and post to Discord again, forever. Injected lines are remembered and consumed, so one injection produces exactly one echo, and a player genuinely repeating the same text later still reaches Discord.
What is the anonymous usage counting?

Off by default. When enabled it records only which public record ids were answered, how many questions went unanswered, and which module names those questions mentioned. It never stores question text, file paths, hostnames or usernames, and --preview-telemetry shows the exact payload first.
What is the offline assistant bot?

tools/assistant_bot.py answers questions about Log Client by searching the generated datasets. It is retrieval, not a language model: it returns the best matching record and says when nothing matches, so it cannot invent a setting that does not exist. No API key and no network needed.
What is the keyword webhook routing?

A keyword rule can name its own webhook URL. Precedence is the chat-logger keyword URL, then the relay's keywords= route, then the shared webhook. A route on its own is enough; a shared URL is not required.
